Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 41

“Actions do not bind the one who has renounced action through yoga, whose doubts are severed by knowledge, and who is possessed of the self, Dhananjaya.”

Krishna gathers the chapter's threads — yoga, knowledge, self-possession — into a single sentence. Renouncing action through yoga, not instead of it, is the whole distinction.
